parent.fit_scope: all supplied train and valid groups; parent predictions are distillation targets and provide no held-out evidence

profile_design.objective: Measure real feature-only FP32 parent inference for a small fixed sample before any full export; do not infer full export ETA from the fit profile or this sample alone.
profile_design.group_selection: First 64 target-index row groups in each frozen split order; row-group list digest is emitted in the result.
profile_design.input_reads: Existing sealed FeatureOnlyGroups / SequenceFile path; features only. No targets or masks.
profile_design.predict_path: Existing sealed V4 train_rnn.predict(model, batch, 4000, cuda); FP32 inference flag enabled, state reset per predict call and retained only across 4000-row chunks within each sequence.
profile_design.output_check: For each timed batch, require finite float32 predictions of shape [16,20000,2], hash bytes into a result digest, then discard the array.
profile_design.side_effects: Write only the small profile result JSON atomically. Do not create prediction arrays or alter parent, source, base cache or data.
profile_design.external_observation: The admitted worker observer must record cgroup memory/current/peak/events, actual device VRAM and GPU utilization, worker heartbeat and terminal exit. Worker OOM deltas must remain zero.

prelaunch_gates: H218 cleanfold0 fit has a successful terminal receipt and fixed epoch-3 checkpoint.
The H218 excluded-468 exporter has a valid sealed FP32 prediction artifact and its currently authorized independent grade is terminal.
No other GPU worker or incompatible high-memory CPU job is active; the single GPU lock is free.
The V4 source manifest, root review, recipe, parent contract, parent terminal receipt, provenance and epoch-3 checkpoint hashes still match.
Fresh controller admission confirms the campaign slice limits, available RAM/VRAM and open admission barrier.

profile_resource_proposal.reservation_status: proposal only; must be rechecked and freshly admitted after H218 work releases resources

failure_policy: Preserve every failed result and partial output under its original attempt identity. Any retry gets a new attempt ID and output name. Never launch exports, cache build or student fit automatically from this profile contract.
interpretation_limits: This is a real-input execution profile, not a model-quality result or held-out evaluation.
The all-data parent was fit on both supplied train and valid groups; its predictions are training targets, not held-out evidence.
The timed sample alone is not a full-export ETA; root reviews measured full-export phase timing and resource counters before setting export caps.
No public upload, forecast or promotion is authorized by this contract.
